messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — VectorLink wants a short POC. Request: Dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering + control-plane mTLS. Region preference: ap-southeast1. Target peak ~500 rps, typical payloads ~1.5k tokens. Timeline: 10 business days. Can we pull this off?
Elena (SE): Need model size and max sequence to recommend H100 vs A100. For 1.5k context, H100 gives better headroom for p99 latency.
Dev Ops: Current inventory: limited H100 in ap-southeast1. I'll run an availability probe. Also note Dedicated provisioning requires tenant CIDR, service account, and peer project id.
Mina (PM): I'll collect business ask and confirm whether they're open to a short reserved commit for the POC (gives discount). Sam, please confirm contact.
Sam (AE): Contact is jason@vectorlink.ai. I'll ask if they want reserved pricing.
Elena (SE): Ballpark numbers: 8x H100 might handle ~200-300 rps depending on batching. To reach ~500 rps p99 under 250ms likely need 12 H100 or 16 A100 (if H100 unavailable). A100 requires more replicas for same perf.
Arjun (Security): mTLS for control-plane is doable. We need their CSR and subject info to sign the cert. Also clarify whether logs/traces may leave their VPC. If they require private control plane (no traffic over public control plane), that's a different engagement and adds ~3+ weeks and legal sign-off.
Dev Ops: Provisioning checklist (paste into ops ticket):
```
- tenant_name
- tenant_owner_email
- pool_sku (H100 | A100)
- region (ap-southeast1)
- gpu_count (e.g., 8/12/16)
- tenant_cidr
- peer_project_id / peer_vpc_id
- service_account_email
- csr_pem (if mTLS)
- requested_start_date
```
Dev Ops: I'll do an H100 availability check now. Expect update in 1 business day. If H100 not available, we can propose A100+more gpus.
Mina (PM): Sam — ask them for expected hourly QPS distribution (peak hours), data residency constraints, and whether they need audit logs retained for >90 days.
Elena (SE): For the customer-facing estimate, we should present two options: (A) 12x H100 — estimated sustained p99 ~200ms at 500rps, (B) 16x A100 — estimated sustained p99 ~260-300ms at 500rps, with cost delta. Also include a lower-cost trial: 8x A100 with autoscale/burst enabled to test traffic pattern.
Sam (AE): Will collect those details. Also they asked about a POC discount — can we offer 15%-25%?
Mina (PM): We can offer 20% POC discount pending approvals. I'll start the approval thread.
Arjun (Security): Send the security questionnaire items they'll need to answer: data flow diagram, TLS/mTLS cert plan, retention policy, and any regs (PDPA/GDPR) to confirm.
ops-bot: Example ops payload for ticket: 
```
{
  "tenant_name": "vectorlink-poc",
  "pool_sku": "H100",
  "region": "ap-southeast1",
  "gpu_count": "12",
  "tenant_cidr": "10.60.0.0/22",
  "peer_project_id": "vectorlink-prod",
  "service_account_email": "sa-vectorlink@vectorlink.ai",
  "csr_pem": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----\n...\n-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----"
}
```
Elena (SE): I'll draft the quick perf/cost bullets and drop them here once I have the A100 vs H100 numbers. Dev Ops — tag me on the capacity check result.
Dev Ops: Will do. Starting probe now.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll push the ask to Jason and update this thread with CIDR and contact details. :thumbsup:
